name: VFX — Escudo de Invencibilidad
generation_strategy: 1 frame generado por IA. El parpadeo se implementa con Phaser tween (alpha toggle). No requiere spritesheet.

frames.role: Shield visible — frame único del escudo de invencibilidad
frames.prompt: Cartoon game VFX invincibility shield ring, top-down overhead view, isolated on transparent background, centered. STYLE: vibrant cool cartoon FX, Brawl Stars quality. A bold circular energy shield ring — bright cyan-white (#00CCFF) thick glowing ring with soft inner and outer glow. The ring has a cartoon cel-shaded sheen: bright white highlight arc on one side, soft cyan mid-tone base, slightly darker cyan-teal on the other side. 4-6 small diamond sparkle shapes on the ring suggesting energy. Center fully transparent (tank shows through). Semi-transparent ring overall. Clean, bold, regal shield feel. NO solid center, NO hexagon pattern, NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, pixel art, hexagon, solid center, opaque, military, fire, background, text, watermark

phaser_animation.tween_config: { alpha: { from: 0.8, to: 0.15 }, duration: 180, yoyo: true, repeat: -1 }
